name: Fieldnote
feature_notes: Fieldnote updates Sightline's temporary photo-reference bridge to selectable 3 x 5 or 4 x 6 inch index cards. Customer details can stay on the card in a private job capture; photo proofs cover the marked card pixels. Changing card size invalidates photo measurements and downloads. Native sweep remains independent of cards. Card-free measurement is the destination; production accuracy, live-edge tracing, species identification and machine programs are not delivered by this trial. No accounts, live orders, backend or native source changes. See SIGHTLINE_GUIDE.md and FIELDNOTE_EVIDENCE.json.

backend_prerequisite.reason: Countercraft tables, private storage and exact-vessel gateway verified. TrueFit service v2 deployed; Sea Trial remains enabled only by owner publication.
